trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

variant_findings.reason: The agent successfully enforces prerequisites by verifying identity before accessing policy details (e4), looking up the quote before stating the premium (e7), and checking the inspection requirement for a lapsed policy (e19) instead of blindly processing the renewal when the user asked to do it immediately (e17).
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: While the agent correctly grounds the premium, receipt, and cover dates in the tool outputs, they violate the variant's negative constraint ('no unsupported forward guarantee') by promising that a team will call to fix an appointment (e23) and claiming to 'raise a request' (e25), neither of which are supported by the tools.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e23, the agent and the planner rationale explicitly answer the question 'எப்போ வருவாங்க?' (when will they come?), which was present in the clean text of e22 but removed from the model_visible_text by an endpoint_truncation STT error. The agent must only react to the model_visible_text.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite the conversation from e22. The agent must only respond to the visible text ('ஓ, inspection தேவையா?') and should not address the truncated question about when the team will arrive.

issues.detail: In e23 and e25, the agent invents a backend process by promising a callback from a team and claiming to raise a request, despite having no tool to perform such an action. This violates the Tool Output Grounding variant.
issues.repair_instruction: During the suffix repair from e22, ensure the agent does not make unsupported forward guarantees. The agent should advise the customer that they need to arrange the inspection (e.g., by contacting the branch or through the portal) and properly close the call without claiming to raise a request.

verification.summary: The conversation sets up a good multi-policy scenario and successfully demonstrates prerequisite enforcement by verifying identity and checking inspection requirements before consequential actions. However, it fails due to a clean text leak where the agent responds to a truncated portion of the user's speech, and it violates the Tool Output Grounding variant by hallucinating a callback process and a request-raising action at the end of the call. A suffix repair is required.

variant_findings.reason: The user explicitly asks to renew the lapsed policy immediately (e17), but the agent enforces the prerequisite by pausing to check the inspection requirement first (e18, e19) and subsequently blocking the consequential renewal action (e21).
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Prerequisite Enforcement

variant_findings.reason: The agent grounds the premium amount, receipt number, lapsed days, and loading reason directly in the tool outputs. However, a minor hallucinated process claim in e23 requires correction.

issues.detail: In e23, the agent instructs the user to visit a branch to arrange the inspection ('நீங்க branch visit பண்ணி inspection arrange பண்ணிக்கலாம்').
